newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech shares end bullish week with further gains.
newsitem.headline: Czech shares end bullish week with further gains.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index rounded off a bullish week with another upward session led by major issues CEZ and Komercni Banka.
The PX50 rose 0.4 percent to 557.8 while the major issue dominated RPIX recovered from early falls to close up 0.3 percent to 1,151.8.
Power utility CEZ was the biggest major issue gainer, rising 19 crowns to 1,046 and Komercni Banka moved up 15 crowns to 2,385.
Analysts said the strong performance of Czech shares was partly attributable to new year excitement although they cautioned that activity had been generally quite low and mainly domestically driven.
"I don't think foreign investors will really come back until they clean up here," said Lindsay Ashford of Zivnostenska Banka.

As 1996 progressed equities investors expressed greater and greater worries about the lack of transparency in the Czech capital markets and the lack of adequate enforcement of what regulations there are.
The Prague Stock Exchange has promised to set up a US style securities and exchange commision watchdog by this summer and the government has also pledged to tighten capital market legislation.
